review_type: Independent AI contextual Amharic textual adjudication, not native certification

decisions.reason: The complete phrase names equal width, not approximate likeness. The new Writer equal-width control supplies this exact constituent in a numerical-width setting, and its tooltip binds the expression to equal widths. Removing only the table-specific scope phrase yields a coherent property caption; the app dialog and Apply-to-all supply the input scope. In both opener and title positions the noun phrase names the intended common-width configuration, rather than claiming that clicking the opener has already applied it. This exceeds component lookup and resolves the original common-versus-similar concern for the revised value.
decisions.attestation: Exact two-word constituent in a longer same-dimension control, not an exact whole standalone caption.

prior_decision.confidence: Medium lexical/structural plausibility; insufficient full-label semantic/idiomatic assurance for release.
prior_decision.reason: The draft is a plausible adjective-plus-dimension noun phrase, but this review cannot sufficiently establish that the complete short label unambiguously means one equal/common width rather than similar width. The LO Fontwork and locale records plus the AOSP dimension noun are not full-label validation. No mistranslation is established; the hold is evidentiary, not an instruction to rewrite.
prior_decision.release_condition: A competent contextual Amharic review must assess the complete phrase as both the toolbar opener and dialog title, with exact shared width and independently proportional cropped heights. An exact corpus match is not a universal requirement, but component lookup alone is not enough.
prior_decision.semantic_check: The toolbar opens the WIDTH dialog; it does not immediately normalize. Apply later gives all assembly inputs the same selected-axis pixel target. Other dimensions follow each crop ratio, subject to integer rounding. No equal file size, area, whole-image shape, or equal height claim.
prior_decision.alternative_disposition: እኩል ስፋት remains an unaccepted alternative. Do not substitute it solely to remove an English ambiguity without complete-label review.

preserved_alternatives.note: Original shorter equal-width alternative built from attested LO equalization construction. Not an exact full-phrase source match or accepted substitution.

decisions.whole_label_confidence: medium-high, lower evidentiary directness than width
decisions.reason: The whole phrase applies equality to the image-height scalar. AOSP establishes this head noun in image dimensions; the new equal-width noun phrase establishes the productive equality-plus-dimension construction, and prior Equalize Height confirms the relation transfers to height, although its noun differs. In this assembled-image dialog, equal height is not equal vertical position: the noun names extent, and no position or alignment term occurs. The same property-label form works for the opener and title without asserting immediate application. No grammatical agreement or suffix change is triggered by replacing the bare width head with the bare height head. This is an independently endorsed productive adaptation, not acceptance inferred only from the noun.
decisions.attestation: Exact standalone two-word target not established in the bounded corpus.

prior_decision.confidence: Medium lexical/structural plausibility; insufficient full-label semantic/idiomatic assurance for release.
prior_decision.reason: AOSP supports ቁመት for image height, while the actual LO Same Letter Heights record uses እርዝመት. The proposed shortened/substituted phrase is new. Its exact common-height reading, rather than similarity or vertical alignment, is not sufficiently independently established by the retained evidence.
prior_decision.release_condition: Review the complete phrase in both toolbar/title uses with common height, crop-proportional widths and all-input scope. Prior acceptance of the dimension noun cannot stand in for this check.
prior_decision.semantic_check: The toolbar opens the HEIGHT dialog, not immediate resizing. Apply normalizes selected-axis height for every input and computes each width separately from that image crop, subject to integer rounding. No matching shape, equal width or aligned-position claim.
prior_decision.alternative_disposition: Preserve the real LO እርዝመት variation and both supplied alternatives without silently accepting or flattening them.

decisions.whole_label_confidence: medium-high, more formal register than dimension labels
decisions.reason: The full nominal phrase names a function preserving proportionality. The existing contiguous phrase in actual width/height resizing prose establishes the object-function relation; the new aspect-ratio GtkCheckButton independently supports a preservation-noun label as an on/off option, rather than only running prose. The complete label has no fixed-size, imported-original, restoration, position or security-lock claim. Checked activates preserving the current gesture-start relation; unchecked deactivates that named function, so the stable noun phrase is coherent in both states. Neither setting needs to be phrased as a current-state assertion. This combination resolves the prior checkbox-register gap without falsely asserting an exact standalone match or native review.
decisions.attestation: Exact phrase within same-function resizing prose plus a new same-function checkbox construction using different aspect-ratio terminology; no exact standalone target match claimed.

prior_decision.production_key_status: Absent in supplied production values-b+am catalogue; no implementation performed.
prior_decision.confidence: High consumer meaning; medium compositional semantic support; insufficient independent confidence in the standalone checkbox idiom.
prior_decision.rationale: The candidate is a contiguous phrase in same-function LibreOffice explanatory prose, and maintaining proportionality matches the feature. However, extracting this nominal phrase does not by itself establish a clear standalone on/off checkbox label. I cannot confidently endorse its checkbox-state idiom from these records alone. This is an evidence/idiom hold, not a finding that the phrase is grammatically wrong, and not a blanket rule requiring every new translation to have an exact full-phrase precedent.
prior_decision.verified_consumer_meaning: ClassicPaintActivity.kt:761..764 toggles lockSelectionAspect. PaintCanvas.kt:617..642 uses initialSelectionRect for the current gesture. SelectionGeometry.kt:28..60 scales both current dimensions together for corner and edge drags. It preserves the current gesture-start ratio, not necessarily the source-image ratio, and does not freeze movement, rotation, or size or repair prior distortion.
